rca of the issue: Bug: '$497' still shown in Recruitment app course header and module breadcrumbs. Reproduction: (1) POST /api/auth/login with module-tester creds, (2) GET /app/recruitment/self-guided -> heading renders 'Board Recruitment — $497 Self-Guided System', (3) GET /app/recruitment/self-guided/module/1 (and 2..6) -> back-breadcrumb '← Board Recruitment — $497 Self-Guided System'. RCA: /app/frontend/src/member/CoursePages.jsx defines PRODUCT_META['self-guided'] = {..., label: 'Board Recruitment — $497 Self-Guided System'}. This label is rendered as the overview page H1 and as the back-link on every module page, so the cleanup pass missed this centralized string. Mitigation: change the label to 'Board Recruitment — Self-Guided System'. Suggested regression check: assert !document.body.innerText.includes('$497') on /app/recruitment/self-guided and on /app/recruitment/self-guided/module/1.
